command.description: Fallback agent command when the conductor supplies none. Default `claude`.

open.description: Overview terminal of a fresh worktree; `{}` opens nothing. Templates expand {identifier}, {branch}, {title}, {worktree_path}.

root.description: Main clone; otherwise derived from the git common dir.

launch_watch.description: Launch-watch windows: wait start_timeout_ms (default 60000) for the wrapper to start, then timeout_ms (default 4000) in which an immediate agent exit fails the launch.

adopt_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Orca to adopt a worktree. Default 35000.

worktree_dir.description: Directory (relative to root, or absolute) for new worktrees. Default `.bakers-worktrees`.

base_branch.description: Base ref for new branches. Default: the upstream of the root's HEAD.

tab_label.description: Terminal title template; must contain {identifier}. Also {state}, {title}, {title_slug}, {run_uuid}, {workspace_path}.
